describes: A variant of the pack's paint rule made from data alone (the houses' first pass, to prove the materials are data): every house red in slam paint with white trims, as the town painted its outbuildings and backs. Not the town's rule.

care.neglect: an event 'neglected' with amount a (per mille) from its year lengthens every later interval by 1 / (1 - a/1000); 'boarded' over the whole house stops repainting until 'unboarded'; 'restored' and 'repainted' put on a coat in their year
care.windowsNew: a window put in by an event 'windows_replaced' comes painted in its year, in the period's window colour

notes.variant: Changed from paint.json: one period (red bodies, white trims and windows), slam paint throughout (materials/paint-slam.json), a repaint every 10-20 years. The colours, weather and care rule are the pack's.
